notes: James Davolos is a Portfolio Manager and Research Analyst at Horizon Kinetics. The New York-based asset manager and investment advisory firm manage over $4.5bn, an established industry presence for more than 25 years. James is the co-portfolio manager of the firm’s new Inflation Beneficiaries ETF (INFL) and manages Horizon’s Internet Fund, as well as several private and institutional accounts. Having started on Horizon’s trading desk in 2005, James quickly progressed to begin his tenure on the investment team by December 2006. We discuss what sets Horizon’s value, contrarian-oriented approach apart; James explains Predictive Attributes and how they give Horizon their edge; and finally, James takes me through the firm’s unique INFL ETF, up nearly 19% since inception in January – enjoy the interview!  Search Home New Top Charts Sign In May 13, 2021 James Davolos - The Inflation ETF, Dollar Debasement & 'Predictive Attributes' CMC Aureon Sessions – Invest in the Next Big Idea 1h 2m James Davolos is a Portfolio Manager and Research Analyst at Horizon Kinetics. The New York-based asset manager and investment advisory firm manage over $4.5bn, an established industry presence for more than 25 years.

James is the co-portfolio manager of the firm’s new Inflation Beneficiaries ETF (INFL) and manages Horizon’s Internet Fund, as well as several private and institutional accounts. Having started on Horizon’s trading desk in 2005, James quickly progressed to begin his tenure on the investment team by December 2006.

We discuss what sets Horizon’s value, contrarian-oriented approach apart; James explains Predictive Attributes and how they give Horizon their edge; and finally, James takes me through the firm’s unique INFL ETF, up nearly 19% since inception in January – enjoy the interview!
